## The business

- Name: Scottsdale Sprinters. Luxury chauffeured ground transportation in Scottsdale, Phoenix and across Arizona.
- Also known as: Scottsdale Sprinters Buses and Limos (our DBA, and the name on our Google Business Profile). Registered company: Scottsdale Sprinters LLC.
- Official site: https://scottsdalesprinters.com. The official website of Scottsdale Sprinters (Scottsdale Sprinters Buses and Limos) is scottsdalesprinters.com. Reservations: call or text (623) 986-6339, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.
- Official profile (Google Business Profile): https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12053649981209255634
- Official profile (Yelp): https://www.yelp.com/biz/scottsdale-sprinters-scottsdale
- Official profile (Facebook): https://www.facebook.com/people/Scottsdale-Sprinters/61575217370390/
- Official profile (Instagram): https://www.instagram.com/scottsdalesprinters
- Official profile (Threads): https://www.threads.com/@scottsdalesprinters
- Official profile (MapQuest): https://www.mapquest.com/us/arizona/scottsdale-sprinters-776461175
- Official profile (Yahoo Local): https://local.yahoo.com/info-238539732-scottsdale-sprinters-scottsdale/
- Phone (call or text): (623) 986-6339. Email: reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.
- Hours: Book online any hour. Quotes answered 8am–8pm Arizona time, seven days. Booked after 8pm? We confirm by 8am. Rides booked during desk hours (8am–8pm) are confirmed right away.
- Lead time: Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.
- Proof: 5.0-star Google rating (544 Google reviews), 4.9 stars on Yelp.
- Fleet: Vehicles range from luxury SUVs to Sprinters, limos, party buses, mini coaches and 56-passenger motorcoaches, professional chauffeur service included, and groups of 1,000 to 2,000 guests move on coordinated multi-vehicle service.
- Extras: Add-ons include decorations of every kind, custom signs, a custom AI song, non-alcoholic refreshments, premium Fiji water and most custom touches a limo can offer.
- Background and MVR checked: Every chauffeur, no exceptions.
- Drug screened: Every chauffeur on the roster.
- Trained, experienced, attentive: The people our repeat clients ask for by name.
- Detailed between every trip: Not at the end of the day. Bottled water on every ride.
- Locally owned: Owned and run in Scottsdale for twenty-plus years.
- Licensed: A permitted, licensed commercial operator, not a marketplace.
- Insured: Commercial coverage on every vehicle in the fleet.

## How pricing works

- Scottsdale Sprinters books every vehicle by the hour at a published hourly rate ($125–$325) with a published minimum number of hours. There is no per-seat pricing.
- How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout.
- Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. There is no booking fee, no service charge and no fuel surcharge. Gratuity is optional.
- Published rates and minimums per vehicle: https://scottsdalesprinters.com/pricing
- Cost per person at full load, with tax, for every vehicle: https://scottsdalesprinters.com/guides/how-much-does-a-party-bus-cost-scottsdale

## Start a quote links

- Each fleet entry carries a `Start a quote` link to that vehicle page on this site. The person supplies date, time, passengers and locations there, and the server calculates the current quote from those details.
- The catalog line and the link are not a quote, a confirmed fit, an availability verdict, a reservation or a hold.
- Seated capacity is published. Luggage and whether a vehicle suits a particular occasion are confirmed with us, not assumed from the seat count.
- Availability is checked separately and is point-in-time until the website creates a hold through its own guarded customer flow.

## Policies

Last updated September 2026. Source: https://scottsdalesprinters.com/policies

### Terms of service

#### 1. Acceptance of terms
By booking transportation with Scottsdale Sprinters you agree to these terms. If you do not agree to them, please do not book.

#### 2. What we provide
Chauffeured ground transportation: airport transfers, corporate travel, weddings and celebrations, day trips and private charters, in the vehicles listed on the fleet page. Bottled water is on board for every ride and it is the only complimentary amenity; anything else is an add-on you choose at checkout.

#### 3. Pricing
Every price we quote is before tax. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. There is no service charge and no booking fee, and gratuity is optional and never added for you. Every date is quoted from the published table, including the major-event dates named in the cancellation policy; what varies by date is availability. Rates and minimums for each vehicle are on the pricing page.

#### 4. Deposits and balance
How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout. Where a balance is charged to a card, a card that declines may cost you the reservation, so tell us in advance if it needs to be replaced.

#### 5. House rules and fees
The full house rules are on the ride rules page. Three of them carry a fee:
Smoking or vaping, $1,500. The smell does not leave the cabin, so the vehicle comes off the road.
An excessive spill, $450. Minor spills are never charged.
A biohazard clean, $450. The deep clean after someone is sick.
One more fee is not a house rule at all: on a transfer, each stop beyond the pickup and the drop-off is $50. An hourly or daily charter has already bought the time, so its stops add nothing.
Passengers are expected to treat the chauffeur and the vehicle with respect. Illegal substances and drinking under 21 are prohibited, and the chauffeur may end a trip that becomes unsafe.

#### 6. Damage authorization
You accept the vehicle in the condition it is in at pickup; tell your chauffeur straight away if anything is wrong. Your chauffeur photographs the interior before every trip for our internal records. You authorize us to charge the card on file for damage beyond normal use. We never charge for damage without showing you the photographs first.

#### 7. Our guarantee
If the vehicle at pickup isn’t the one you booked, the ride is free. Not discounted, not credited — free.

#### 8. Liability
We carry commercial insurance on every vehicle. We are not liable for delays caused by traffic, weather or anything else outside our control, and personal belongings left in a vehicle remain your responsibility — though we will always try to get them back to you.

#### 9. Changes to these terms
We may update these terms. The date at the top of this tab tells you when they last moved, and the terms in force are the ones published when you booked. Questions: reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

#### 10. SMS Terms
When you give us a mobile number, you agree to booking texts about that reservation: the confirmation, the chauffeur’s arrival, and changes on the day. Follow-ups and offers are separate. We send those only if you check the box that asks for them, and you can leave it unchecked.
Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to opt out of texts, or HELP for help. We do not sell your number or share it for anyone else’s marketing. Questions: reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com or (623) 986-6339. Text (623) 986-6339.

### Privacy policy

#### What we collect
What a trip needs and nothing else: your name, email and phone number, the pickup and dropoff addresses, your trip details, and payment information. We do not sell any of it.

#### What we use it for
Confirming and running your trip, reaching you about it, invoicing it, and — only if you have agreed — telling you about an offer. That is the whole list.

#### Who else sees it
Four processors help us run the business, and each sees only the part it needs:
Our payment processor, Stripe, takes the payment. Card numbers go straight to Stripe and never touch our systems.
Our hosting and database provider stores the website and the reservation records.
Our reservations CRM is where our team works your booking, and the system that sends our text messages.
Our email delivery provider sends confirmations, invoices and reminders.
Ask us and we will name any of them. Beyond those four, we share information only when the law requires it.

#### Text messages
Giving us your mobile number means we may text you about your reservation: confirmations, the chauffeur’s arrival, and anything that changes on the day. Marketing texts are separate and go out only if you opt in. Reply STOP to any message to stop them, or HELP for help. Message and data rates may apply, and we never sell or share your number for anyone else’s marketing.

#### How long we keep it
Reservation and payment records are kept for seven years, because tax and insurance rules require it. Marketing contact details are deleted when you unsubscribe. Anything else is deleted once it no longer serves the trip it was collected for.

#### Security
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and payments are processed through PCI-compliant systems. Only the people who need a record can open it.

#### Your rights
Ask us for a copy of what we hold, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com and we will answer within thirty days.

#### Cookies
The site uses cookies to keep you signed in and to understand which pages people use. Your browser settings control them.

### Cancellation policy

Every reservation is held by the payment you make at checkout. The short version: free cancellation up to 14 days before pickup, and inside the window you lose what you paid to hold the date. Major-event dates run a 60-day window: what you paid to hold the date is non-refundable and anything left comes back if you cancel 60 or more days out.

#### Standard trips
SUVs and single-vehicle Sprinter bookings — airport, point-to-point or hourly.
14 or more days before pickup: full refund — no fee, no questions.
Between 72 hours and 14 days: we keep the deposit and refund the rest.
Inside 72 hours, or a no-show: we can’t refund, because the vehicle has been off the market for you.

#### Large groups and party buses
Any booking of 20 or more passengers, two or more vehicles, or a wedding.
30 or more days out: full refund.
Between 14 and 30 days: we keep the deposit and refund the rest.
Inside 14 days, or a no-show: no refund.

#### Major-event dates — a 60-day window
These dates run on a longer window, and the deposit on them is non-refundable:
60 or more days out: we refund the balance and keep the deposit.
Inside 60 days, or a no-show: no refund.
The dates: Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale, WM Phoenix Open, Cactus League spring training weekend, New Year's Eve, Prom weekend. Prom weekends are Fridays and Saturdays in April and May; spring-training weekends are Saturdays and Sundays through the Cactus League season. Super Bowl week joins the list for any year the game is played in the Valley.
Most Scottsdale operators make these dates non-refundable the moment you book. We don’t.

#### Need to move it instead?
Ask us 72 or more hours ahead and we’ll move your date once, free, subject to availability — your deposit comes with you and the new date’s rate applies. That’s usually the better call. Inside 72 hours a date change is treated as a cancellation. Time, pickup address and vehicle changes are handled by the reservations team at any time, subject to availability.

#### If we cancel
Weather, mechanical, anything on our side — you get 100% back or a free reschedule. Your choice.

#### How to cancel
Use the cancellation link in your confirmation email, text (623) 986-6339, call (623) 986-6339, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

#### Refund processing
Refunds are issued within 3 to 5 business days. Your bank may take another 5 to 10 business days to show it.

## House rules

Source: https://scottsdalesprinters.com/ride-rules

- Please do: Dance, if the vehicle you booked has a floor for it.
- Please do: Play your music as loud as you like. Just not "the neighbors call the cops" loud.
- Please do: Passengers 21 and over bring their own alcohol, and we do not sell it. Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container policy, A.R.S. § 4-251, allows it, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip.
- Please do: Bring your playlist and your people.
- Please do: Ask your chauffeur for anything. Stops, temperature, volume, a photo. Really.
- Please do: Settle in and enjoy the ride. That is the whole point.
- Please do not: No eating or food inside the vehicle. Drinks are fine; snacks wait for the next stop.
- Please do not: No underage drinking. Anyone under 21 stays on soft drinks.
- Please do not: No standing on the seats or sitting on the seat backs.
- Please do not: No heels or shoes on the seats. They are leather and they remember.
- Please do not: Take your trash with you at the end. Cans, cups, confetti, all of it.
- Please do not: Be kind to your chauffeur. They are the reason everyone gets home.
- Please do not: No smoking or vaping of any kind. The smell does not leave, so this one carries a fee. ($1,500)
- Please do not: Keep the drinks in the cups. Minor spills are fine; a can or two on the floor counts as excessive and carries a cleaning fee. ($450)
- Please do not: If someone gets sick in the vehicle, we have to deep clean it, and that carries a cleaning fee. Pace yourselves. ($450)

## Frequently asked questions

Source: https://scottsdalesprinters.com/faq

### Booking and reservations

#### How do I book a vehicle?
Book Scottsdale Sprinters online: choose a vehicle, pick your date and pickup time, add any stops, and confirm. You get an emailed confirmation with the details straight away. If you would rather talk it through, call or text (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

#### How far in advance should I book?
Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.

#### Can I book a party bus or Sprinter for tonight?
Yes, when a vehicle is free that night. Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. For tonight, call or text (623) 986-6339 and the reservations team checks which party buses and Sprinters are still available.

#### When will someone get back to me?
Book online any hour. Quotes answered 8am–8pm Arizona time, seven days. Booked after 8pm? We confirm by 8am. Rides booked during desk hours (8am–8pm) are confirmed right away.

#### Can I modify my reservation?
Yes. Ask us 72 or more hours before pickup and we'll move your date once, free, subject to availability — your deposit travels to the new date and the new date's rate applies. Inside 72 hours a date change is treated as a cancellation. Time, pickup address and vehicle changes are handled by the reservations team at any time, subject to availability.

#### What payment methods do you accept?
Scottsdale Sprinters accepts all major credit cards — Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover — plus Apple Pay and Google Pay at checkout.

#### Do you set up corporate accounts?
Monthly invoicing with PO and cost-center fields is available — ask reservations at reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

### Pricing and minimums

#### How is pricing determined?
Scottsdale Sprinters prices charters by the hour: the vehicle's published hourly rate multiplied by your billable hours, from $125 to $325 an hour across the fleet. There is no per-mile charge, no service fee and no booking fee. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout, and gratuity is optional.

#### Is there a minimum number of hours?
Yes: every Scottsdale Sprinters vehicle has a 4-hour minimum on an hourly charter, except the 56-passenger motorcoach, which has a 5-hour minimum. Airport and point-to-point transfers are priced as a trip instead, with no hourly minimum: flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and beyond that priced from the drive, with the empty return included and the basis shown on the quote.

#### Do longer bookings cost less per hour?
Yes: Scottsdale Sprinters bookings of 7 hours or more earn free hours that come off your billable hours automatically. Book 7 to 11 hours and one hour is free; 12 to 14 hours and two are free; 15 hours or more and three are free.

#### How much is the deposit?
It depends on how you pay, and you choose that at checkout. How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout.

#### What is added at checkout?
Arizona sales tax of 8% is the only thing Scottsdale Sprinters adds to the quoted fare. There is no service charge, fuel surcharge or booking fee. One promo code can be applied per booking, capped at 10%.

#### Do extra stops cost anything?
Only on a transfer or round trip, where each added stop is $50. On an hourly charter stops are complimentary — you have already bought the time.

#### Is a round trip cheaper than two transfers?
Yes: book the return leg together with the outbound leg and Scottsdale Sprinters takes 20% off the return.

#### Is gratuity included?
Gratuity is optional, is never added automatically, and goes 100% to your chauffeur — add it at checkout or hand it over in person.

#### Do your rates change with the season?
Scottsdale Sprinters quotes normal dates from one published hourly rate table; for the major-event dates named in the cancellation policy, availability and pricing are confirmed in writing for your date. The pricing page shows the current rates and vehicle minimums. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.

### Cancellations and refunds

#### What is your cancellation policy?
Cancel 14 or more days before pickup and you get a full refund. Between 72 hours and 14 days we keep the deposit and refund the rest; inside 72 hours the reservation is non-refundable. Large groups, party buses and weddings (20+ passengers or two or more vehicles) get a full refund 30 or more days out and keep-the-deposit terms down to 14 days. Major-event dates — Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale, WM Phoenix Open, Cactus League spring training weekend, New Year's Eve, Prom weekend — run on a longer window of 60 days, and the deposit there is non-refundable: cancel 60 or more days ahead and the balance is refunded; inside 60 days nothing is refunded. If we ever cancel on our side, you get 100% back.

#### How do I cancel my booking?
Cancel with the link in your Scottsdale Sprinters confirmation email, or call or text (623) 986-6339. We confirm every cancellation in writing.

#### When will I receive my refund?
Refunds are issued within 3 to 5 business days. Your bank may take another 5 to 10 business days to show it.

### Vehicles and services

#### What vehicles do you offer?
Scottsdale Sprinters offers chauffeured vehicles seating 6 to 56 passengers, and no sedans: Luxury SUV (Suburban) (seats 6), Chrysler Limo (seats 8), Maybach Shuttle Sprinter (seats 8), Maybach Jet Sprinter (seats 9), Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) (seats 13), Executive Black Sprinter (seats 14), Executive White Sprinter (seats 14), Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter (seats 15), Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) (seats 16), Pink Hummer Limo (seats 18), Mini Bus (24 Pax) (seats 24), Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) (seats 27), Party Bus (28 Pax) (seats 28), Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) (seats 29), 56-Passenger Motorcoach (seats 56). Vehicles range from luxury SUVs to Sprinters, limos, party buses, mini coaches and 56-passenger motorcoaches, professional chauffeur service included, and groups of 1,000 to 2,000 guests move on coordinated multi-vehicle service.

#### What vehicles does Scottsdale Sprinters run?
Scottsdale Sprinters runs chauffeured vehicles seating 6 to 56: luxury SUVs (6 seats); Maybach, executive, limo and party Sprinters, from the 8-seat Maybach Shuttle Sprinter up to 16 seats; limousines (8 to 18 seats); party buses (28 seats); executive mini buses and mini coaches (24 to 29 seats); and 56-passenger motorcoaches. Larger groups move on several vehicles booked together.

#### Is the Maybach Jet Sprinter a Mercedes-Maybach?
It is a custom Maybach-edition build on a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter (Mercedes-Maybach does not sell a Sprinter van), seating 9 with room for 4 checked bags and 8 carry-ons. Scottsdale Sprinters lists it as the Maybach Jet Sprinter.

#### What comes with the vehicle?
Every Scottsdale Sprinters ride comes with bottled water, and that is the only complimentary amenity. Anything else — a greeter, refreshments, a custom sign, a child seat — is an add-on you choose at checkout, and cabin features vary by vehicle, so check the vehicle page.

#### Can I request specific amenities?
Yes, as priced add-ons: greeters, refreshments, custom signage and child seats are chosen at checkout, and decorations and anything vehicle-specific are confirmed in writing before payment.

#### Do you offer airport pickup?
Yes: Scottsdale Sprinters picks up at Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX), Scottsdale Airport (SCF, also coded SDL) and Phoenix-Mesa Gateway (AZA). Scottsdale Sprinters holds the Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) ground transportation permit. Your chauffeur tracks your flight. An optional greeter meets you at baggage claim with a name sign and helps with your bags for $200 flat on airport transfers, confirmed with your quote.

### Safety and chauffeurs

#### Is Scottsdale Sprinters a legitimate company?
Yes. Scottsdale Sprinters is Scottsdale Sprinters LLC, doing business as Scottsdale Sprinters Buses and Limos, a locally owned chauffeured transportation company in Scottsdale, Arizona, and it is permitted, licensed and insured. Reviews: 5.0 from 544 Google reviews as of September 29, 2026, and 4.9 stars on Yelp. Official profiles: Google Business Profile (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12053649981209255634), Yelp (https://www.yelp.com/biz/scottsdale-sprinters-scottsdale), Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/people/Scottsdale-Sprinters/61575217370390/), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/scottsdalesprinters). Book only through scottsdalesprinters.com or the reservations line, (623) 986-6339.

#### Are your chauffeurs licensed and insured?
Yes: every Scottsdale Sprinters chauffeur is background and MVR checked, drug screened, trained and experienced, and the company is permitted, licensed and insured, with commercial coverage on every vehicle.

#### How are your vehicles maintained?
Scottsdale Sprinters vehicles are inspected on a maintenance schedule and detailed between every trip, not at the end of the day.

#### Are there rules on board?
Yes, a short list: no smoking or vaping, no eating inside the vehicle, no standing on the seats, and no drinking under 21. Three of them carry a fee: $1,500 for smoking or vaping, $450 to deep-clean an excessive spill and $450 for a biohazard clean. An added stop on a transfer is $50. The full house rules are on the ride rules page.
